summary: Tested Layout Options & Variants system for Layout Configurator. Found and fixed critical bug (missing X icon import). All 5 requested features verified.

critical.issue: Missing X icon import from lucide-react caused ReferenceError when rendering variant delete button

features_tested.details: Tab 'Варианты' exists in left panel under 'Элементы' section, displays options and variants correctly

features_tested.feature: Кнопка 'Nowa opcja' открывает диалог создания опции
features_tested.details: Button opens dialog with fields: Nazwa (PL), Nazwa (RU), Anuluj/Utwórz buttons. Option created successfully and appears in list

features_tested.feature: Кнопка 'Zapisz jako wariant' при выбранном элементе
features_tested.details: Button appears when element is selected on canvas. Opens dialog showing: Option selector, Nazwa wariantu (PL/RU), selected element info (type, position, rotation, scale)
14/14 pytest tests passed: CRUD for options, CRUD for variants, error handling for nonexistent resources, invalid JSON handling

features_tested.feature: Применение варианта перемещает элемент на сохранённые координаты
features_tested.details: Clicking on variant applies saved position/properties to matching element. Toast message 'Применён: [variant name]' confirms application

bug_fixed.root_cause: The X icon component was used in JSX (<X className='h-2.5 w-2.5' />) on line 4059 but was not imported from lucide-react
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added 'X' to the lucide-react import statement

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fixed: Missing X icon import in LayoutConfiguratorPage.jsx
All features implemented correctly according to requirements
seed_data_creation: Test data (TEST_Pozycja grzejnika option with TEST_Pozycja lewa variant) was created during testing and cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout Options & Variants system fully functional. Path: Login (admin/admin123) -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки tab -> 'Варианты' tab in left panel. Create options with 'Nowa opcja', add elements to canvas, select element and click 'Zapisz jako wariant', click variant to apply saved position.
